messages:
sana: Heads-up — CS is seeing a sudden spike of 503s for hosted inference (hosted-v1). Multiple customers reporting timeouts and one flagged a billing duplicate. Can SRE look?
maria: Seeing alert flood from api-gateway -> 5xx rate up ~12x since 10:18 UTC. Correlates with worker restarts on cluster-east-1.
ops-bot: alert: upstream-runner-restart-rate high on cluster-east-1 (10:17:42 UTC) — 98 restarts / 10m
chao: I pulled a few runner logs. Getting repeated segfaults in the attention kernel immediately after prefetch stage. stack shows CUDA pagefault -> SIGSEGV -> container exit.
kevin: We rolled out quantized v2 to canary yesterday. Canary had low traffic. Did we promote to more nodes this morning? @deploy-bot can you confirm rollout events?
deploy-bot: deploy: quantized-model/v2 promoted to 30% of hosted-v1 at 09:55 UTC; autoscale enacted for additional runners at 10:05 UTC.
maria: Repro pattern: high QPS + long context requests = prefetch spike -> some runners OOM then segfault, kube restarts container before KV cache restore finishes -> panic during cache replay and crash loop.
sana: Customers reporting: 1) transient 503s, 2) higher end-to-end latency, 3) in one case, duplicate billing event recorded for failed requests. Support ticket #5213.
kevin: Duplicate billing is likely from client retrying idempotently and server returning delayed 5xx after charge event. Need to confirm payment system logs but prioritize stopping the crash loop.
chao: Quick mitigation: scale down canary to 0%, rollback quantized-model/v2. Also enable fallback routing to cpu-variant to avoid OOMs. I'll open a rollback patch.
maria: Pushing kill switch to routing policy now: route-hosted-v1 -> if runner-restart-rate > 5 then fallback to cpu-variant in same region.
kevin: Patch applied, reducing percent to 0 at 10:28 UTC.
maria: After rollback, restart-rate dropped to normal within ~2m. But we still have remnants: some pods keep restarting on prefetch replay, causing short-lived 503s.
chao: Captured a sample log from a failing runner (truncated):

```
[2026-06-12T10:20:31Z] prefetch: loading kv for model quantized-model/v2 ctx_len=16384
[2026-06-12T10:20:31Z] cuda[0]: pagefault at 0x7f9b3c... kernel attention.cu:line 342
[2026-06-12T10:20:31Z] runtime: SIGSEGV (code=1, addr=0x7f9b3c...)
[2026-06-12T10:20:31Z] backtrace: atn_kernel+0x1f4, kv_replay+0x9b, runner_main+0x3ab
[2026-06-12T10:20:31Z] container: exit code 139
```

chao: Repro steps I used locally: 1) launch runner with model=v2 quant, 2) send 2x long-context requests concurrently (context=16000 tokens), 3) observe OOM/pagefault in ~3rd request.
maria: Can we add a short-term config change: cap max_context for quantized-model/v2 on hosted to 8192 and reject requests > that with 400 until we have a proper fix?
kevin: Agree. Add server-side soft-limit with clear error so clients don't retry blindly. Also enable a circuit-breaker on prefetch stage to avoid replay into crashed state.
chao: I'll add the soft-limit and circuit-breaker. Also going to add a guard in kv_replay: if prefetch failed with pagefault, don't attempt replay, mark runner unhealthy and let orchestrator drain gracefully.
sana: CS update: telling affected customers we rolled back canary and routing fallback is active; asking them to resume traffic. Notifying Billing to hold duplicate-charge investigations.
ops-bot: note: billing-service flagged potential duplicate charge events for request-ids: [r_8a3f, r_8a40] between 10:19-10:27 UTC — investigating.
kevin: Postmortem action items I'm logging now:
- rollback quantized-model/v2 (done)
- soft-limit context=8192 for quantized variants
- circuit-breaker + prefetch guard
- add additional e2e test for long-context quantized replay
- billing: dedupe logic for charge confirmation on 5xx

maria: For triage: collect core dumps from affected pods (if any), nvcc/gpu-driver versions, and full coredump backtraces. I'll leave nodes cordoned until we confirm driver stability.
chao: One more note: local repro only repros under multi-request concurrency. This suggests a race in KV cache initialization under concurrency. I'll instrument locks and add an assertion failure to catch it early.
sana: Thanks all — CS will follow up with the customer once billing team confirms. I'll keep ticket #5213 open and post updates here.
kevin: Good work. Keep updates minimal here; move longer notes to the incident doc (INC-2026-134) and I'll own the follow-up.
